qcom,kryo.reason: CPU and cache topology nodes consumed by arm64 architecture code (CPU enumeration, cacheinfo), not by platform drivers.

arm,arch-cache.reason: CPU and cache topology nodes consumed by arm64 architecture code (CPU enumeration, cacheinfo), not by platform drivers.

android,firmware.reason: Read by Android first-stage init from /proc/device-tree/firmware/android, not by a kernel driver.

arm,scp-shmem.reason: SCMI shared-memory region referenced through the shmem phandle of the SCMI node; arm_scmi parses it without matching this compatible.

slim217,221.reason: SLIMbus device matched by slim_device_id {0x217, 0x221} in drivers/bluetooth/btfm_slim.c, not by an OF table.

qcom,smmu-kgsl-cb.reason: KGSL IOMMU context-bank child parsed from its parent by kgsl_iommu.c.

qcom,msm-imem.reason: IMEM container; its children are looked up by their own compatibles by enabled drivers (memory_dump_v2, boot_stats, qcom-dload-mode, qcom_pil_info, f_diag, vendor hooks).

qcom,msm-imem-restart_reason.reason: Read only by the legacy msm-poweroff driver (CONFIG_POWER_RESET_MSM), which Xiaomi's mondrian configuration leaves off; reboot reasons use qcom-reboot-reason (PON).

arm,primecell.reason: AMBA device (CoreSight) matched by peripheral ID tables on the AMBA bus, not by an OF compatible.

arm,coresight-cti.reason: CoreSight CTI is an AMBA driver (amba_id cti_ids) matched by peripheral ID.

qcom,va-minidump.reason: Debug feature built only by Xiaomi's mondrian_consolidate.config debug variant; the production gki variant used here leaves it off.

qcom,msm-rtb.reason: Debug feature built only by Xiaomi's mondrian_consolidate.config debug variant; the production gki variant used here leaves it off.

arm,embedded-trace-extension.reason: Debug feature built only by Xiaomi's mondrian_consolidate.config debug variant; the production gki variant used here leaves it off.

qcom,gh-vm-loader-sec.reason: Gunyah secure-VM (trusted UI) loader and TLMM sharing; not enabled by any Xiaomi mondrian configuration.

qcom,tlmm-vm-mem-access.reason: Gunyah secure-VM (trusted UI) loader and TLMM sharing; not enabled by any Xiaomi mondrian configuration.

qcom,ipcc-self-ping.reason: IPCC self-ping debug client; no driver exists in the Xiaomi mondrian-s-oss kernel.

xiaomi-touch.reason: Xiaomi touch-feature class node; the driver is not in Xiaomi's public mondrian source. The Goodix Berlin driver exposes double-tap and FOD gesture control itself.

xiaomi,hardware-info.reason: Xiaomi hardware-info reporting node used by MIUI/HyperOS apps; driver not published by Xiaomi and not required by AOSP.
